serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Me? 
Policeman: Yes! You!
Policeman: Why is that whenever something happens you are lurking around? Huh? 
You: I-I don’t know! 
You: What exactly happened? 
Policeman: Nothing happened! That’s classified!
…
You: Alright, forget I asked then.
#Policeman.Face.normal
Policeman: What is this? Some kind of…{{wi}} reversal psychology? I kinda want to tell you now about it to be honest, but I will keep my mouth shut! 
Policeman: Yeah, I have seen through you, pale guy. Why aren’t you already asleep, huh?
You: Like I said before, I like nighttime walks. It isn’t that weird.
Policeman: Hmm… Aren’t you scared? Walking at night, that is. This isn’t the safest area around, you know? I for sure feel threatened, I already called for backup. 
…
Policeman: My partner is already on her way, so don’t try anything funny!
You: Ok…
